chunks: So do not become weak-kneed and sue for peace, for you will have the upper hand as God is with you and will not overlook your deeds.

key_terms.الْأَعْلَوْنَ: the upper hand / those with superiority
key_terms.يَتِرَكُمْ: deprive you or withhold from you

ai.seo_question: What does it mean to 'not become weak-kinned' in the context of divine support?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a directive for strategic patience rather than permanent hostility, emphasizing that 'being higher' refers to spiritual and military readiness rather than arrogance. It underscores the divine guarantee that sincere efforts in the path of God are never wasted, reinforcing the concept of *fa'il* (doer) accountability in Shia theology.
